phase_reason: latest job event reason code, read from a separate read-only snapshot; it may lead or lag state by one event
progress_reason: lifecycle step count from the job event log; not an encode fraction; share_export reports no incremental progress

limitations: Source/native master stays intact. Lossy sharing video and AAC are not a preservation master, recovered stem, listening acceptance or automatic adoption.

H.264 veryfast/CRF27/720p/AAC96 default; HEVC can be slow locally. CRF does not guarantee file-size reduction or an exact byte limit. Square-pixel video without side data is required; copy accepts H.264/HEVC within requested height.

Checks rational packet presentation timing/extent, source before-after hash, delivery decode, rate/channels and AAC priming/padding allowance. Reencoding is not source decoded-frame or exact PCM identity, nor proof of physical capture sync.

At most one video encode and two audio attempts, up to3dB audio attenuation to meet measured -1.5dBTP. Native8..192kHz/1..8 channels and duration<=300s; generated qualification covers mono/stereo; source/output<=3GiB. Two threads, owned logs4MiB per stream, compact16KiB and receipt64KiB.

Known domain failures remain tool errors with bounded staging/recovery receipts, including possible/committed publication. Inspect exact receipts before retrying; missing sidecar alone does not prove absence.

Worker cleanup covers its recorded owned children under the inner deadline; generic outer group fallback does not establish containment of distinct child sessions or unknown publication after a wedged worker.

unknowns.cpu_seconds_reason: not measured; no OS CPU quota is applied
unknowns.low_register_preservation_reason: lossy AAC sharing derivative; ~32 Hz content is not measured by this lane
unknowns.memory_bytes_peak_reason: not measured; no OS memory quota is applied
unknowns.musical_review_reason: no note-correctness, missed-note or phrase verdicts are made by a job service
unknowns.source_duration_seconds_reason: unknown until the worker reports it; admission does not probe
unknowns.worker_birth_reason: ps lstart recorded for the latest attempt
